patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors and content arrangements, creating a strong visual break between narrative segments.
Extreme contrast between oversized, geometric display headings and small, standard sans-serif body text, used to emphasize key narrative points.
A limited, high-contrast palette centered around a vibrant orange, black, and light greys/dark blues, used to define distinct section moods.
A dramatic scroll-triggered reveal of a full-screen 3D WebGL scene, followed by abrupt background color changes and content reveals as the user scrolls down the page.
Narrative-driven sections that unfold sequentially, each with a distinct visual style, from a dynamic 3D hero to historical image blocks and typographic statements.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-screen WebGL or canvas rendering to display a dynamic 3D scene of the island, with large, semi-transparent text overlaid directly onto the rendered environment.

Scroll-triggered animations are employed to transition between full-bleed sections, changing the background color dramatically and revealing new content blocks with a hard cut or quick fade as they enter the viewport.
Large, custom-font headings are used as primary visual elements, often occupying significant screen real estate and contrasting sharply with smaller body text to create visual hierarchy and impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold, geometric display headings (~4-5x body text size) with small, regular-weight body text and even smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — no visible rounded corners on elements or buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy; the hero is very airy, while content sections maintain generous vertical spacing.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its dramatic use of a full-screen, interactive 3D WebGL scene as the primary hero, which seamlessly transitions into bold, high-contrast typographic and image-based narrative sections. The abrupt shifts in visual style and color palette between these immersive sections create a unique storytelling experience.
